statement: Whenever min_operations_queries returns a result r, for every index j with 0 <= j < len(queries), writing queries[j] = [a_j, b_j], we have r[j] = |E(a_j,b_j)| - max_{1 <= w <= 26} cnt(a_j,b_j,w), where E(a,b) is the multiset of weights of the edges on the unique simple path from a to b in the given tree (E(a,a) is empty), and cnt(a,b,w) is the number of occurrences of weight w in E(a,b). Equivalently, r[j] is the minimum number of edge-weight changes needed so that all edges on the path from a_j to b_j have one common weight.
preconditions: n is an integer with 1 <= n; len(edges) = n - 1; each edges[i] has length 3, and if edges[i] = [u_i, v_i, w_i] then 0 <= u_i, v_i < n and 1 <= w_i <= 26; the undirected graph on vertices 0..n-1 with these edges is a tree. Also len(queries) = m with m >= 1; each queries[j] has length 2, and if queries[j] = [a_j, b_j] then 0 <= a_j, b_j < n.
